analyst.summary: Go Digit is a digital-first general insurer with decent, if unspectacular, profitability (around 12% return on equity), but its revenue growth has slowed sharply in the most recent year to just 7%, down from a much faster historical pace, while the stock still trades at a rich valuation and has underperformed across every recent time horizon. We rate this a Sell given the price does not yet reflect the growth slowdown.
